run_REINFORCE_experiment: run a REINFORCE reinforcement learning experiment on CartPole-v0 with multi-device multiprocessing
create_env_vecenv: create a vectorized DeviceEnv from multiple Gym environments with step limits and device placement
create_agent_reinforce: create a ReinforceAgent with an action model and baseline model on a specified device
create_gym_env: create a single Gym environment instance by name using gym.make
review_Experiment_class: review the Experiment class that extends Reinforce and creates action and baseline models
